summary: The filing is a 6-K of CHEMICAL & MINING CO OF CHILE INC (SQM) reporting Q1 2026 earnings. It discloses revenues of $1,760.1M, net income of $364.7M ($1.28/sh), and operational updates on lithium, SPN, and iodine. There is no mention of a merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private, restructuring, or other special situation. The content is a routine earnings release and is not a special-situation event.
